decisions.reason: The source specifies referral-mint success-modal wording; the FAQ already explains that a successful referral awards a $5 commission and one $500-draw ticket, so its content remains valid unchanged.
The source changes an on-screen mint-success modal and does not change email delivery, notification triggers, or email contents.
The referral-mint success-modal message does not alter landing-page hero copy or layout.
The source describes feedback shown after a code-used mint but does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, or reset behavior.
The source explicitly concerns a mint where a referral code is used and does not modify allocation for missing or invalid referral codes.
The modal repeats the existing $5 commission and prize-ticket outcome but does not change the $15 primary-mint revenue allocation.
The source specifies modal copy rather than About-page content, and the existing About-page referral and ticket descriptions remain consistent with it.
The source does not request any Mission-page copy change and does not alter the reward mechanics already summarized there.
The source changes user-facing success feedback but does not change how commissions or tickets must be recorded or displayed in accounting views.
The source does not mention Transak, fiat conversion, supported payment methods, or fiat-mint fulfillment.
The modal wording does not change embedded-wallet provisioning, purchase confirmation, reward access, or cashout guidance for fiat buyers.
The source states that a ticket goes to the chosen referred NFT holder but does not change draw eligibility, ticket weighting, randomness, or winner selection.
